dependency_discipline.c2_consumption: every failed H-yes vector imports one literal full element of the frozen C2-U correspondence at its own full public h2
dependency_discipline.local_selection_forbidden: Round 1 neither repairs nor optimizes over the internal strategies of an imported C2 element; the complete mapping from h2 to C2 elements is part of the Round-1 assessment
dependency_discipline.mutation_rule: a byte change to the Gate 0 bundle, R2 batch, or C2-U interface invalidates this candidate and every descendant

export_domain_gate.consumer_rule: after this exact repaired candidate receives independent PASS, r1_batch_frozen, entry_unanimity, institutional_comparison, and manuscript-survival consumers may consume every primitive-admissible N>=3 case; no consumer may replace any nonclosed C2 endpoint by its unattained infimum
export_domain_gate.N3_closure_method: five explicit attained cases split by G=1-o_1, beta, and mu; they use posterior-zero C2 elements on reached separating H-yes failures and posterior-one C2 elements only at globally off-path histories
export_domain_gate.reopening_rule: any loss of attainment, Bayes alignment, public-history measurability, or exact frozen-C2 membership at N=3 reopens the full-domain export

state_key.recognition: one of m=N-1 weak proposers is drawn uniformly and independently of theta and h1

primitive_problem.population: N=m+1>=3; recognized weak proposer i is counted yes and J_i contains n=N-2 weak nonproposer voters
primitive_problem.type: theta in {0,1}; only H observes theta; 0<=o_0<o_1<=y_bar<=1
primitive_problem.proposal: s_i=(y,(x_j)_{j in J_i}); 0<=y<=y_bar; x_j>=0; r_i=1-y-sum_j x_j>=0
primitive_problem.ballot: H and all voters in J_i act simultaneously; conditional behavioral randomizations are independent
primitive_problem.passage: the current agreement passes exactly when H and all voters in J_i choose yes
primitive_problem.current_pass_payoffs: H receives y, voter j receives x_j, and proposer i receives r_i
primitive_problem.H_no: immediate irreversible opt-out; H receives o_theta in Round-1 units, every weak state receives zero, and no continuation is reached
primitive_problem.H_yes_weak_failure: H remains active and the full revealed vector reaches its own selected C2-U element
primitive_problem.equality: yes is selected when a payoff-relevant expected comparison is equal; zero relevance permits an explicit completion

full_vector_notation.weak_vector: w in {0,1}^J records every weak nonproposer vote; bold 1 is the all-yes vector
full_vector_notation.failure_history: h2^Y(w)=(h1,i,s_i,H=Y,w,failed ballot) for every w distinct from bold 1
full_vector_notation.literal_selection: kappa(h2^Y(w))=(nu_w,alpha_2,w,(c_k,w^theta)_{k,theta},(D_w^theta)_theta,strategies,beliefs) is one single exact element of the frozen pre-recognition C2,U(h2^Y(w);nu_w) correspondence
full_vector_notation.native_continuation_payoff: c_k,w^theta is player k's type-conditional payoff in native Round-2 units; D_w^theta is the undiscounted terminal-outcome distribution
full_vector_notation.history_specificity: equal posteriors do not identify kappa across different full vectors; every failed vector keeps its own assessment selection, although a construction may choose outcome-equivalent elements when the frozen correspondence contains them

continuation_projection_and_map.source_projection: c_k,w^theta and D_w^theta are projections of the same selected pre-recognition C2 element kappa(h2); they are not selected directly from the recognized-proposer scalar payoff projection
continuation_projection_and_map.domain: complete public failed histories h2=(h1,i,s,H=Y,w,failed ballot) together with their public posterior nu(h2)
continuation_projection_and_map.type_blind_rule: kappa is indexed by the public history h2 and never by privately known theta; one call kappa(h2) returns both theta=0 and theta=1 coordinates, and coordinatewise splicing from different C2 elements is forbidden
continuation_projection_and_map.membership_rule: kappa(h2) must belong to frozen C2,U(h2;nu(h2)); membership is checked at the Bayes posterior on every positive-probability history and at the explicitly assigned posterior on every globally off-path history
continuation_projection_and_map.outcome_equivalence_rule: two action-specific selections are outcome-equivalent only when the same public posterior, internal strategy and belief kernels, both-type all-player payoff coordinates, and both-type terminal-outcome kernels agree; equality of node names, scalar payoffs, or passage status is insufficient
continuation_projection_and_map.measurability_rule: the proposal-indexed maps rho_i(s), h_i,theta(s), p_i,j(s), and the public-history map kappa_i(h2) are Borel-measurable assessment components; sigma_i is a probability measure on the feasible proposal set

belief_interface.proposal_ballot_belief: rho_i(s) is the weak voters' belief at the ballot following proposal s
belief_interface.on_support_proposal: rho_i(s)=mu because the recognized weak proposer is uninformed
belief_interface.globally_off_path_proposal: rho_i(s) is an explicit assessment component in [0,1]
belief_interface.positive_probability_failure: if a proposal is on the support of sigma_i, Q_p(w)>0, and d=(1-mu)h_0+mu h_1>0, Bayes gives nu_w=mu*h_1/d; in particular nu_w=0 under h=(1,0), nu_w=1 under h=(0,1), and nu_w=mu under h=(1,1); the type-independent weak-vector probability cancels
belief_interface.zero_probability_failure: if the proposal, H-yes event, or vector has zero equilibrium probability, nu_w and kappa_i(h2) are explicit off-path assessment components subject only to membership in the frozen C2-U correspondence
belief_interface.deviation_evaluation: a voter at the current ballot evaluates type-conditional payoffs using rho_i(s), while future strategies are those inside the action-specific selected kappa_i(h2); a proposal deviation is evaluated under the true preproposal mu
belief_interface.weak_vote_information: a weak vote is not direct evidence about theta, but the public H vote can update the posterior
belief_interface.degenerate_beliefs: both H-type actions and both type-conditional payoff vectors remain recorded when mu or rho is zero or one
belief_interface.posterior_membership_alignment: the nu_w used in Bayes, the posterior field of kappa(h2), the frozen C2 membership test, and every payoff/outcome projection must be the same value

action_consequence_map.H_yes_all_weak_yes: current Round-1 implementation with payoff vector (r_i,(x_j),y)
action_consequence_map.H_yes_weak_failure: payoff beta*c_k,w^theta for every player k; outcome probabilities are D_w^theta and are not multiplied by beta
action_consequence_map.H_no_any_weak_vector: immediate terminal payoff (all weak zero,H=o_theta); beta never multiplies o_theta
action_consequence_map.outcome_signature: current passage, immediate opt-out, or the full selected continuation interface including beliefs, strategies, type/player payoffs, and outcome distributions; a raw vector alone is not a payoff consequence

hegemon_ballot_fixed_point.relevance: positive with probability one because H-no implements immediate opt-out whereas H-yes either implements inclusion or preserves active-H continuation
hegemon_ballot_fixed_point.response: h_theta=1 if Delta_H(theta)>=0 and h_theta=0 otherwise
hegemon_ballot_fixed_point.mixing: none; equality is a relevant comparison and selects yes
hegemon_ballot_fixed_point.no_global_payment_cutoff: y>=o_theta is valid only when Q_p(bold 1)=1; failure continuations enter every other case

weak_ballot_fixed_point.relevance_probability: R_j is the rho-weighted probability, over theta and every vector w_-j, that H chooses yes and the two action-specific outcome signatures differ
weak_ballot_fixed_point.response_positive_relevance: if R_j>0, p_j=1 when Delta_j>=0 and p_j=0 when Delta_j<0
weak_ballot_fixed_point.response_zero_relevance: if R_j=0, any p_j in [0,1] is an assessment completion; exact outcome-signature equality implies Delta_j=0
weak_ballot_fixed_point.same_quota_branch: when both actions fail, beta times the two distinct type-conditional C2 payoffs still enters Delta_j; unchanged passage status never by itself proves irrelevance
weak_ballot_fixed_point.independence: the simultaneous behavioral probabilities p_j form a product distribution; no correlating device is added

necessary_and_sufficient_conditions: every kappa_i(h2^Y(w)) is a literal member of the frozen C2-U correspondence at its full history and recorded posterior
Bayes' rule holds at every positive-probability reached failure history
both H types satisfy the hegemon ballot fixed point
every weak voter satisfies the weak ballot fixed point over the complete vector space
fixed_proposal_theorem.closed_form_status: the assessment fixed point is exact; a single threshold or scalar continuation value is not an equivalent representation

type_conditional_payoffs.outcome_distribution: combine current passage, immediate opt-out, and each D_w^theta using h_theta and Q_p(w); beta changes dates of payoffs, not probabilities
type_conditional_payoffs.budget_fact: the outside option is external to the unit weak surplus

components: Borel probability measure sigma_i on the feasible proposal set
one complete fixed-proposal assessment element A_i(s) at every feasible proposal, including every deviation
full type/player payoff and terminal-outcome distributions
proposal_stage_assessment.map_measurability: rho_i(s), h_i,theta(s), p_i,j(s), every payoff/outcome kernel, and kappa_i(h2) are public-history-measurable; kappa_i is type-blind
proposal_stage_assessment.sequential_rationality: every support pair (s,A_i(s)) maximizes V_i against all feasible proposals evaluated with their proposal-contingent assessment elements and the true mu
proposal_stage_assessment.tie_break: after proposer maximization, support elements minimize Hbar among proposer maximizers; if both quantities tie, retain different payment, continuation, belief, and outcome distributions
proposal_stage_assessment.mixing: proposal mixing is allowed only across support elements tying in both V_i and Hbar
proposal_stage_assessment.necessary_and_sufficient_PBE_characteriz: a complete proposer assessment is a PBE if and only if every proposal-indexed ballot element satisfies the fixed-proposal theorem, beliefs obey the stated Bayes restrictions, and the support satisfies maximization plus the frozen tie-break
proposal_stage_assessment.selection_status: set-valued; no equilibrium selection beyond the frozen equality and proposer tie conventions

secured_pooling_current_passage.conditions: p_j=1 for all j, h_0=h_1=1, y>=o_1, and for every voter the complete-vector IC against its unilateral failed-history continuation is nonnegative; proposal maximization and the tie-break must also hold
secured_pooling_current_passage.interpretation: a current agreement includes H for both types; the direct y cutoff is valid here only because all weak votes are sure yes

secured_low_type_current_passage.conditions: mu<1, p_j=1 for all j, h_0=1,h_1=0, o_0<=y<o_1, each complete-vector weak IC is nonnegative, and proposal maximization plus the tie-break hold
secured_low_type_current_passage.interpretation: the low type is included and the high type immediately opts out

flat_continuation_failure_ballot.conditions: N>=4, at least two weak voters choose no with probability one, and every unilateral weak switch selects an outcome-equivalent C2 element across the still-failed histories
flat_continuation_failure_ballot.weak_response: every such weak action has zero relevance and is an admissible completion
flat_continuation_failure_ballot.H_response: type theta chooses yes exactly when beta*E_p[c_H,w^theta]>=o_theta
flat_continuation_failure_ballot.proposal_stage_warning: this is a ballot construction; it becomes an on-path proposer PBE only after proposal maximization and the tie-break are verified against all assigned deviation assessments

universal_zero_weak_value_PBE_for_Nge4.construction: after every proposal set every weak nonproposer to no and h_theta=1 exactly when beta*o_theta>=o_theta; after a positive-probability H-yes failure first compute nu(h2) by Bayes and then select from frozen pre-recognition C2,U(h2;nu(h2)) the canonical coordinated-failure element: a fixed feasible R2 proposal at each recognition node, deterministic all-no weak ballots after every R2 proposal, both R2 H types yes, every weak payoff zero, and both H coordinates c_H^theta=o_theta; this explicit element varies only in its recorded nu and is measurable; use an explicitly assigned posterior and the same canonical class at globally off-path h2
universal_zero_weak_value_PBE_for_Nge4.posterior_cases: if beta=1, h=(1,1) and nu=mu; if beta<1 and o_0=0, h=(1,0) and every reached H-yes failure has nu=0; if both outside options are positive and beta<1, H-yes failures are off path
universal_zero_weak_value_PBE_for_Nge4.selection_alignment: for failed histories connected by one weak switch after the same proposal, choose frozen elements with the same posterior and outcome-equivalent internal strategies, beliefs, both-type payoff vectors, and outcome kernels; the map remains one public-history-indexed, type-blind kappa
universal_zero_weak_value_PBE_for_Nge4.ballot_rationality: every weak switch leaves another no and reaches an outcome-equivalent zero-weak-payoff continuation; H follows its exact full-vector IC
universal_zero_weak_value_PBE_for_Nge4.proposal_optimality: every feasible proposal gives the proposer zero and H its expected outside payoff, so all proposals tie in both the proposer objective and the frozen H-payoff tie-break
universal_zero_weak_value_PBE_for_Nge4.existence: proves nonemptiness and attainment for every N>=4, mu in [0,1], beta in (0,1], and admissible outside options

universal_N3_PBE.notation: G=1-o_1, D=1-o_0, c_G=G/2 when G>0, and c_0=D/4 when G=0
universal_N3_PBE.C2_G_positive: for every posterior nu, kappa^G_nu is the symmetric frozen C2 pooling element: each R2 recognized proposer offers y_2=o_1 and zero to the other weak state, so each weak identity has both-type pre-recognition payoff c_G and H has both coordinates o_1
universal_N3_PBE.C2_G_zero_nu_zero: kappa^0_0 is the symmetric frozen C2 separating element with each recognized proposer offering y_2=o_0+D/2, zero to the other weak state, and retaining D/2; each weak identity has low-type pre-recognition payoff c_0=D/4 and H's low coordinate is o_0+D/2
universal_N3_PBE.C2_G_zero_nu_one: kappa^0_1 is the frozen C2 element with R2 proposal y_2=1 and all weak payments zero; both weak type coordinates are zero and both H coordinates equal one
universal_N3_PBE.case_G_positive_beta_less_1: on path propose (y,x)=(o_1,beta*c_G), all current voters yes, and obtain V=G(1-beta/2); after every off-path proposal set rho=1, weak no, and select kappa^G_1, giving every deviation at most (1-mu)beta*c_G<V
universal_N3_PBE.case_G_positive_beta_equal_1: let P=c_G, R=D-c_G, S=(1-mu)R; choose pooling (o_1,c_G) if P>S and separating (o_0,c_G) if S>=P; off path at rho=1 choose weak no with kappa^G_1 when x<c_G and weak yes when x>=c_G; every deviation is bounded by max{P,S}, and equality P=S selects separation because it gives H strictly less whenever mu<1
universal_N3_PBE.case_G_zero_beta_less_1_mu_less_1: on path propose (o_0,beta*c_0), low H and the weak voter yes, high H no, and obtain (1-mu)(D-beta*c_0)>0; the reached weak-no history has posterior zero and selects kappa^0_0; every off-path proposal uses rho=1, weak no, and kappa^0_1, so its payoff is zero
universal_N3_PBE.case_G_zero_beta_equal_1_mu_less_1: on path propose (o_0,c_0) and obtain V=(1-mu)(D-c_0)>0 using kappa^0_0 after the reached weak-no history; at off-path y<1 use rho=1, kappa^0_1, and a measurable p(s)>0 small enough that high H opts out, low H accepts, and (1-mu)p(s)r(s)<V; y=1 has zero residual
universal_N3_PBE.case_G_zero_mu_equal_1: on path propose (1,0) and choose all yes; if beta<1 use rho=1, weak no, and kappa^0_1 off path; if beta=1 and y<1 use any strictly positive weak-yes probability so high H opts out, and at y=1 use weak yes with zero feasible residual; every proposal gives the sole supported high type's weak proposer zero and H one
universal_N3_PBE.Bayes_alignment: the on-path G=0 separating weak-no history uses nu=0, never nu=mu unless mu=0; posterior-one elements are used only behind globally off-path proposals; G>0 pooling weak-no histories use nu=mu
universal_N3_PBE.nonclosed_endpoint_handling: when G=0 the frozen N=3 C2 value set at nu<1 is open at zero; the construction uses the attained positive element kappa^0_0 with c_0=D/4 and never inserts the missing endpoint
universal_N3_PBE.existence: proves nonemptiness and attainment for every N=3, mu in [0,1], beta in (0,1], and admissible outside options

survival_findings.historical_P_label: if P denotes a both-type current agreement, its outcome motif survives conditionally as the secured pooling subclass, not as a universal outcome or an imported formula
survival_findings.historical_L_label: if L denotes low-type current passage with high-type opt-out, its outcome motif survives conditionally as the secured low-type subclass, not as a universal outcome or an imported formula
survival_findings.historical_R_label: if R denotes deliberate failure followed by active-H continuation, its outcome motif survives conditionally only through a full failed-vector assessment satisfying all weak and H fixed-point inequalities
survival_findings.three_label_exhaustiveness: rejected for the current PBE object: history-specific C2 selections, immediate opt-out branches, gifts, zero-relevance completions, proposal mixtures, and full outcome distributions are not generally represented by one of three scalar labels

pre_recognition_C1_correspondence.validated_domain: N>=3 after independent acceptance of this repaired candidate
pre_recognition_C1_correspondence.assessment_index: alpha selects one complete recognized-proposer PBE element e_i=(sigma_i,rho_i,h_i,p_i,kappa_i) for each i=1,...,m; selections may be identity-asymmetric and every component is measurable as specified above
pre_recognition_C1_correspondence.within_recognizer_type_payoff: E_sigma_i[U_k^i(theta;e_i)]=integral over feasible s of U_k^i(theta;s,e_i) sigma_i(ds), computed separately for every player identity k and both theta coordinates
pre_recognition_C1_correspondence.weak_ex_ante_mu_projection: V_{W_k,U}^alpha(h1;mu)=(1-mu)C_1,U^alpha(h1)_{W_k}(0)+mu C_1,U^alpha(h1)_{W_k}(1); this mu integration is performed only after sigma and recognition integration and remains separate by weak identity
pre_recognition_C1_correspondence.optional_cross_weak_summary: bar V_W,U^alpha=(1/m)sum_k V_{W_k,U}^alpha may be reported as a summary but never replaces the identity vector for collective entry
pre_recognition_C1_correspondence.outcome_distribution: for each theta, integrate under the same sigma_i and then the same uniform recognition weights the aligned current-passage, immediate-optout, and history-specific R2 outcome kernels selected by that same alpha; payoff and outcome coordinates may not use different selections
pre_recognition_C1_correspondence.history_index: the full h1 and mu remain distinct indices; equal mu does not force a common assessment selection
pre_recognition_C1_correspondence.selection_status: set-valued; on N>=3 the full type-by-identity payoff, belief, strategy, payment, continuation-selection, and outcome correspondence—not a scalar projection—is exported to the R1 batch freeze

bounds_and_boundaries.weak_bounds: for every equilibrium element, each weak payoff lies in [0,1] and the sum of weak payoffs is at most one, type by type and ex ante
bounds_and_boundaries.hegemon_bounds: for every type theta, o_theta<=C_1,U,H(theta)<=1 because H can choose immediate opt-out at every reached ballot
bounds_and_boundaries.N_equal_3: there is one weak nonproposer and no coordinated-failure completion; universal proposal-stage existence and attainment follow from the five explicit cases recorded above
bounds_and_boundaries.N_at_least_4: two or more sure no votes make passage impossible after a unilateral weak switch, but zero relevance still requires outcome-equivalent action-specific C2 selections; it is not automatic
bounds_and_boundaries.o_0_equal_0: type zero always chooses H-yes because every H-yes branch payoff is nonnegative and immediate opt-out is zero; equality selects yes
bounds_and_boundaries.beta_equal_1: continuation payoffs enter once without attenuation; immediate opt-out remains undiscounted
bounds_and_boundaries.mu_equal_0_or_1: Bayes applies on supported types and counterfactual type actions/payoffs remain recorded
bounds_and_boundaries.o_1_equal_1: current pooling leaves no residual at y=o_1, but continuation assessments may still matter; no R2 scalar projection is imported
bounds_and_boundaries.C2_nonclosed_boundary: the frozen C2-U N=3 projection has a nonclosed zero endpoint when o_1=1 and nu<1: recognized-proposer values are (0,L_nu], not [0,L_nu]; R1 may not substitute the unattained infimum zero or assume a measurable attaining selector
bounds_and_boundaries.N3_attainment_resolution: the open zero endpoint is never used: when G=0 and mu<1 the construction selects the attained posterior-zero element with c_0=(1-o_0)/4>0; when mu=1 the posterior-one y_2=1 element is attained
bounds_and_boundaries.global_existence: the proposal-indexed fixed-point and maximizer set is exact; the five N=3 cases and the Bayes-aligned N>=4 construction prove universal nonemptiness and attainment on the full primitive domain N>=3
bounds_and_boundaries.multiplicity: whenever several fixed-point elements or double-tied proposal elements exist, the full belief/payoff/outcome correspondence is retained

checks.mechanical_scope: small-N full-vector enumeration, action-specific continuation selections, Bayes/off-path cases, payoff accounting, beta transport, immediate opt-out, bounds, and dependency mutation guards
checks.wrong_posterior_negative_test: must fail whenever posterior=mu is substituted on a separating H-yes history
checks.type_blind_kappa_negative_test: must fail if continuation coordinates are selected by private type instead of one public-history map
checks.domain_gate_negative_test: must accept every N>=3 and reject N<3 or every mutation of the machine-readable full-domain status
checks.analytic_status: proved where marked in the derivation note

invalidation: any change to the exact Gate 0, R2 batch, or C2-U hashes; to simultaneous ballot information; to full-vector publication; to immediate opt-out; to beta dating; to proposal feasibility; to Bayes discipline; or to either frozen tie convention reopens this node and every descendant
